The **V63 Zweihaender** is a unique two-handed melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The **V63 Zweihaender** has Patent SC-00003842. [1] 

A unique, Legendary melee weapon. It has the following default effects:

The weapon can only be obtained as a reward for completing the quest The Eye of the Storm.

The German term "Zweihänder" (meaning "two-hander") refers to a large sword wielded with both hands, a common weapon for mercenaries in 16th century Europe.
